examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as a product page opens with it: the large `title-band` with the overline, headline, sentence and both actions centered. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no title renders nothing, and one with no marks has no client strip.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import HeroBand from '@aziontech/webkit/hero-band'
</script>

<template>
  <HeroBand
    kind="title-band"
    size="large"
    eyebrow="Cache"
    title="Deliver content fast, worldwide"
    description="Serve cached content close to users. Cut origin load and keep applications fast during traffic spikes."
    :primary-action="{ label: 'Start for free', href: 'https://console.azion.com/signup/' }"
    :secondary-action="{
      label: 'Docs',
      href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/',
      trailing: true
    }"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Every layout stacked: `centered` over the dot field with the client strip, the large `title-band`, `pixel-floor` with its copy at the start over the animated floor, and `copy-beside-art` with the illustration beside the copy.
